skill.name: ckm-ui-styling
skill.description: Design accessible React interfaces with shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, and responsive layout guidance. Use theme, accessibility, and canvas design references.
skill.summary: Build accessible, responsive UI systems with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives in documentation, license text, tests, and coverage data. Real issues remain around unpinned npx execution in a helper script and numerous bundled binary font assets that need manual verification.

remediation.suggestion: Pin shadcn to a reviewed version, avoid @latest, require explicit user confirmation, and document that the script modifies the target project.
Publish source URLs and checksums for each font, remove unused binaries, and validate every font with standard font tooling before release.
Rebuild or replace EricaOne-Regular.ttf, Italiana-Regular.ttf, and PoiretOne-Regular.ttf, then confirm they parse as valid font files.

content.user_title: Build Accessible UI with Tailwind and shadcn
content.value_statement: Teams need consistent interface guidance that covers components, styling, accessibility, and responsive behavior. This skill provides shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and visual design references for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides shadcn/ui setup, component selection, and composition for React projects.
Explains Tailwind CSS utilities for layout, spacing, typography, colors, and responsive breakpoints.
Provides accessibility patterns for focus states, forms, dialogs, keyboard support, and screen readers.
Documents theme customization, dark mode, CSS variables, component variants, and design tokens.
Includes Python helpers for adding shadcn components and generating Tailwind configuration files.
Supplies canvas-oriented visual design guidance and bundled font assets for design compositions.
limitations: The guidance is strongest for React, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, and Tailwind CSS projects.
The helper scripts can run local package-manager commands and should require user confirmation.
Visual quality still depends on project context, assets, and manual review.
Bundled font binaries require separate provenance and integrity verification.

use_cases.title: Ship a Responsive Product Screen
use_cases.description: Create a mobile-first page using shadcn cards, forms, dialogs, and Tailwind spacing rules.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Design System
use_cases.description: Define tokens, dark mode behavior, component variants, and accessible interaction states for a shared UI system.

use_cases.title: Improve Accessibility Coverage
use_cases.description: Review focus management, keyboard behavior, form errors, color contrast, and screen-reader announcements.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Basic Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ckm-ui-styling to style a responsive shadcn button and card for a simple signup screen.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Accessible Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an accessible settings dialog with keyboard navigation, focus states, form messages, and Tailwind dark mode styles.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Theme System
prompt_templates.prompt: Define a Tailwind and shadcn theme for a finance dashboard, including tokens, variants, and responsive layout guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React UI for accessibility, layout consistency, dark mode, and shadcn composition. Provide precise changes and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A settings page needs responsive cards, dark mode, and clear form actions.
output: A mobile-first layout plan with stacked cards on small screens and grouped panels on desktop.
Theme guidance for light and dark surfaces, borders, focus rings, and muted text.
Component recommendations for forms, dialogs, alerts, buttons, and status feedback.

output_examples.input: An existing dialog fails keyboard and screen-reader review.
output: A checklist of focus trap, escape key, tab order, title, description, and announcement fixes.
Suggested shadcn and Radix patterns that preserve semantic structure.
Manual validation steps for keyboard-only use and common screen-reader behavior.

output_examples.input: A team wants consistent Tailwind tokens across product pages.
output: A token plan for color, spacing, radius, typography, and breakpoint usage.
Guidance for dark mode variables and component variant naming.
Recommendations for avoiding one-off classes that weaken system consistency.

best_practices: Start with semantic HTML, accessible shadcn primitives, and visible focus states before adding visual polish.
Use Tailwind utilities consistently, then extract reusable components only when repetition is clear.
Test layouts at mobile, tablet, desktop, dark mode, and browser zoom before shipping.
anti_patterns: Running helper scripts without reviewing the exact package-manager command first.
Using dynamic Tailwind class names that are hard to scan, purge, or maintain.
Removing focus indicators or relying only on color to communicate state.

faq.question: What projects does this skill fit best?
faq.answer: It fits React projects that use shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, and component-based design systems.

faq.question: Can it create a full design system?
faq.answer: It can guide tokens, themes, components, accessibility patterns, and responsive rules. Final governance still needs team review.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill documents helper scripts that can run package-manager commands. Users should review and approve those commands first.

faq.question: Does it support accessibility work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for keyboard navigation, focus management, forms, dialogs, contrast, and screen-reader support.

faq.question: Can it help with dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers CSS variables, theme tokens, dark variants, and consistent surface colors.

faq.question: Are the bundled fonts ready to publish?
faq.answer: They should be verified with source checksums and font tooling before marketplace publication.
